config.selection: All21 nondegenerate H822 residual token/block clouds, unchanged.
config.null: Gaussian full standardized residual with exact empirical mean and sample covariance of ALL training occurrences of token, before block selection. Use unchanged encoder Top2 block-L2 gates and decoder.
config.sampling: Three seeds8230-8232 per cloud. Draw until accepted count equals observed active train+validation counts, cap65536 draws. First accepted train count fits local/global PCA; next accepted validation count scores it. Ungated comparison uses first same-count draws from identical stream.
config.geometry: Rank4 affine PCA;32/64 nearest training neighbors; matched observed selected sample counts.
config.limitations: Exploratory reused validation. Null sample covariance may be rank-deficient; no shrinkage or independent covariance fit. Gaussian selection is one null, not proof of smoothness/semantics.
config.numerics: Double precision covariance SVD and draws; cast to float32 before unchanged encoder. Earlier float32 factor audit failed at9.94e-4, rejected.
